future_sampling.policy: Exclude complete consumed components; one question per unused group

fit_diagnostics.what_was_selected: Prompt, symbolic grammar and acceptance policy on development only
fit_diagnostics.interpretation: Descriptive different-context gap, not a causal diagnosis of over/underfitting. Prompt selection can overfit; no local weight-training learning curve exists.

limitations: Historical ID-disjoint samples contain repeated tables/paragraphs; independent-filings and IID calibration assumptions are unverified
Connected source groups conservatively include boilerplate; they can miss paraphrases, edited tables and unknown common filings
Public train/dev contents may be in model pretraining; this audit cannot certify absence
All completed evaluation/calibration contexts are consumed; they cannot be reused as fresh tuning data
No historical row is removed or risk bound recomputed after observing outcomes
